children: Crypto Fund Trader, operated by SWISS RLCRATES AG, launched the CFT Terminal, its own platform for crypto perpetuals and evaluation tracking. It offers more than 600 instruments and is available worldwide to CFT evaluation account holders.
Brings trading in-house, potentially reducing reliance on third-party platforms and broadening the firm's control over its offering.
The release says third-party platform restrictions had affected where prop firms could offer services; broader access may support customer reach.
More than 3,000 traders received beta updates
Shows a substantial waitlist engaged during development, but the release does not disclose conversion or revenue.

This is an operational expansion by a firm that has relied on third-party platforms since 2022, rather than a disclosed financial milestone. Adoption, account-holder usage, or quantified revenue impact would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
